physicalNotes: Radius 0.404 +/- 0.012 solar radii from Thao et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract): 281,063 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.4 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Thao et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3326 +/- 66 K from Thao et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
